Container.Name: eink-hub
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted control center for e-ink photo frames (BLOOMIN8, SwitchBot AI Art Frame, TRMNL firmware and your own ESP32 / Raspberry Pi frames), with Immich integration. Exact previews with smart crop, collections from uploads or Immich, schedules, battery-friendly pull mode and Bluetooth wake.
Set LOCAL_URL to http://[your Unraid IP]:8080: frames on your LAN use it to reach the hub, and "Search the network" scans its subnet. Then open the WebUI and choose an admin password.
Tailscale: with the Unraid 7 Tailscale plugin, turn on "Use Tailscale" in this container. It is already set to Tailscale Serve on port 8080, so the hub gets a private https address (https://eink-hub.[your tailnet].ts.net) that the hub detects by itself and uses for the QR code on the frames. https is also what the phone's Bluetooth wake needs.
Documentation: https://eink-hub-7ba3a3.gitlab.io/guide/unraid
Container.Requires: Optional: the Tailscale plugin (Unraid 7+) for private https access from anywhere.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI and the endpoints frames pull pictures from. If you change it, change LOCAL_URL too.

Config.Name: LOCAL_URL
Config.Description: LAN address of the hub, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 (your Unraid IP and the port above). Frames use it to reach the hub; not localhost.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for schedules and active hours.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Admin password. Leave empty to choose one on first visit.

Config.Name: EXTERNAL_URL
Config.Description: Optional address people use to open the hub (reverse proxy…). The QR code on the frames opens it. With Tailscale Serve turned on it is detected automatically.

Config.Name: IMMICH_URL
Config.Description: Optional Immich address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2283. Can also be set from Settings.

Config.Name: IMMICH_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Immich API key. Can also be set from Settings.

Config.Name: CLOUD_URL
Config.Description: Only for SwitchBot frames: public https address SwitchBot's cloud downloads photos from, when only /u/img is exposed. Empty = EXTERNAL_URL.

Config.Name: AUTH_DISABLED
Config.Description: true turns the admin password off. Only on a trusted network or behind your own auth proxy.

Config.Name: BLE_DISABLED
Config.Description: true turns Bluetooth wake through the host off.

Config.Name: D-Bus (Bluetooth wake)
Config.Description: Optional: set to /run/dbus to let the hub wake BLOOMIN8 frames with the host's Bluetooth (needs BlueZ running on Unraid).
